title: Chrome’s AI-powered Autofill can now dig through your Gmail to fill out forms
script:
Google just updated Chrome with an AI autofill feature that digs through your Gmail.
The updated tool pulls flight confirmations, tracking info, and order details straight from your messages.
It uses that inbox history to automatically fill out web forms for you.
The browser only accesses your private inbox data when you give it direct permission.
Would you let your browser read your emails to complete forms?
